text: Reins of the Pale Riding Crane teach the Pale Riding Crane mount. This item can be purchased for 2,200 Bronze (Pandaria Remix) from Hemet Nesingwary XVII at the Infinite Bazaar during Pandaria Remix.

Reins of the Ebonhide Ramolith teach the Ebonhide Ramolith mount. This item is not currently available. <!--
Regurgitated Mole Reins teach Ol' Mole Rufus, a mole mount. This item drops from the Lurker of the Deeps in the Ringing Deeps.
Reins of the Ascendant Skyrazor teach the Ascendant Skyrazor mount. This item drops from Queen Ansurek in Nerub-ar Palace on Mythic difficulty.
Reingard is an earthen located with Konraada and Matthilde who is resting a book against his back at the Stoneshaper's Atrium in Dornogal.
The Regurgitated Skeleton is vomited up after feeding Rancid Hunk of Flesh to a Carrion Grub in the . It contains Rune of the Resourceful.
Reinforced Beaker is found at the Hallowfall Gate in the Ringing Deeps.
Rehydrated Fish is picked up from the Peculiar Fish in the Sunless Strand for Return to the Sea.
Reins of the Coldflame Tempest teach the Coldflame Tempest, a blue-flamed icy phoenix mount. It is an achievement reward from A Cool Twenty Years.
Reinforced Construct's Greaves drop from Automaxor in the Ringing Deeps.
Reinforced Chitin Chestpiece drops from Kaheti Silk Hauler between Rak-Zakaz and the Crawling Chasm in Azj-Kahet.
Reins of the Frayfeather Hippogryph teach the Frayfeather Hippogryph mount. This item can be purchased for 5,000 from in the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.
Reins of the Brilliant Sunburst Peafowl teach the Brilliant Sunburst Peafowl mount. This mount can be purchased at the Trading Post for 750 Trader's Tender.
Reinforced Anti-Intruder Chainmail drops from E.D.N.A. in the Stonevault.

Reins of the Ivory Savagemane teach the Ivory Savagemane, a raptor mount. During Battle for Azeroth timewalking weeks, this item can be purchased for from Churbro at the Tradewinds Market in Boralus or the Port of Zandalar in Dazar'alor. This mount has a unique summoning animation, in which the rider kneels down in front of an idol while a spirit representation of Gonk appear behind them, before both the idol and Gonk vanish and the mount appears.
Reins of the Celestial Riding Ox teach the Celestial Riding Ox mount. Its source is currently unknown.
Reins of the Celestial Riding Serpent teach the Celestial Riding Serpent mount. This item is a low drop chance from the Coffer of Celestial Chance.
Reins of the Celestial Riding Crane teach the Celestial Riding Crane mount. This item is a low drop chance from the Satchel of Celestial Chance.
Reinforced Stalkerhide Vest drops from Taah'bat and A'wazj in Eco-Dome Al'dani.

Reins of the Felscorned Wolfhawk teach the Felscorned Wolfhawk mount. This mount is an achievement reward from Timerunner: Hunter during Legion Remix. It can also be purchased for 20,000 Bronze from Grandmaster Jakkus at the Infinite Bazaar after earning Timerunner (Legion Remix) on any class. This is a fel-infused version of the .

It can also be purchased for 20,000 Bronze from Grandmaster Jakkus at the Infinite Bazaar after earning Timerunner (Legion Remix) on any class. This is a fel-infused version of the .

Regurgitating Monstrosities are slime giants located in the Pulsing Pit in Nerub-ar Palace.
Reins of the Insatiable Shredclaw teach the Insatiable Shredclaw mount. This item drops from the Final Clutch of Predaxas treasure in the Voidstorm.
Reginald Glarestone is a Forsaken located in Runetotem's Bounty in Razorwind Shores.

Reins of Titan-Reforged Invincible teaches Titan Reforged Invincible, a red colored variant of that is exclusive to Titan Reforged. From 23 September to 25 November 2025, players on who defeated the Lich King in Icecrown Citadel on any difficulty would receive this mount on the Titan Reforged servers. It started distributing to qualifying players' Collections after November 25.

Reins of Inarius' Charger teaches Inarius' Charger, an angelic horse mount. It is a copy of Inarius' Charger from retail. For Titan Reforged and MoP Classic in the China region only, this mount is available through the Treasures of Azeroth event, in which players spend Azerothian Treasure Coins to pull a random prize from a pool. As a form of bad luck protection, it can also be purchased for 100 Shard of Azeroth Fragments, which have a chance to be pulled from the same prize pool.
Reins of Scorching Courage teach Scorching Courage, a fiery, winged horse mount, released as the Lunar New Year mount for 2026. This is a Classic mount; the retail variant is Scorching Valor.
Reinforced Thorium Rocket Chickens are mechanical chickens summoned by Millificent Manastorm in the Assault on Violet Hold.

Reins of the Contained Stormarion Defender teach the Contained Stormarion Defender, a harrower mount. This item has a chance to drop from a Victorious Stormarion Pinnacle Cache, which is rewarded by the Stormarion Assault event in the Voidstorm.
Reinforced Chainmrrl drops from Mrrlokk at Atal'Abasi in Zul'Aman.
Reinforced Amani Haft is a drop from rares in Zul'Aman. When combined with the Tempered Amani Spearhead and the Toughened Amani Leather Wrap it creates the Amani Warrior's Spear.
Reinforced Pouncers are phalynx found at the Citadel of Loyalty in Bastion during The Greater Good.
Reins of the Juvenile Frostwyrm teach Juvenile Frostwyrm, which can be purchased from Jaelof Ironhart or Viktor Felhallow for 300 Platinum Coins since Challenge Mode Season 3.
Reins of the Darkshade Drake teach Darkshade Drake. There is currently no known source for this mount.
Reinforcement Obliteration is an expansion feature achievement earned by disrupting any Ritual Site on Tier 5 with the Reinforced challenge present and kill more than 50 creatures.

Reinforced Wooden Chest is housing decor obtained as a quest reward from Decor Treasure Hunt. Additional copies can be purchased from "Len" Splinthoof in Razorwind Shores and Faarden the Builder in Founder's Point for .
Reinforced Goblin Umbrella is housing decor obtained as a quest reward from Just a Hunch. Additional copies can be purchased from Stacks Topskimmer in Undermine for .
Reinforced Corner Ethereal Pipe Segment is housing decor purchased from Om'sirik in K'aresh for .
Reins of the Bilebound Ur'zul is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 700 Trader's Tender.
Reinforced Wooden Barrel is housing decor purchased from "Len" Splinthoof in Razorwind Shores and Faarden the Builder in Founder's Point for .
Rehoming Technology becomes available after reaching Renown ... with the K'aresh Trust.

Reins of the Pack Kodo teaches Pack Kodo, a kodo mount that can be purchased from Huey Sunnydale or Okamache for 6,000 Merchant's Favor. It requires being with Durotar Supply and Logistics or Azeroth Commerce Authority to purchase.

Reins of the Shadow Dusk Dreamsaber teach the Shadow Dusk Dreamsaber mount. This item is an achievement reward from Glory of the Dream Raider, which involves completing a variety of tasks in the Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope raid.

Reins of the Winter Night Dreamsaber teach the Winter Night Dreamsaber mount. This item drops from Dreamseed Caches and Emerald Bounty reward bags (Large Emerald Bloom, Medium Emerald Bloom, and Small Emerald Bloom). It has a higher chance to drop from the higher-quality reward bags.

Reins of the Rekindled Dreamstag teach the Rekindled Dreamstag mount. This item has multiple sources within the Emerald Dream: *Can be purchased for 1 Seedbloom from Sylvia Whisperbloom or Talisa Whisperbloom after reaching Renown level 18 with the Dream Wardens. *Drops from Gigantic Dreamy Bounty, which is obtained by planting a Gigantic Dreamseed. *Drops from Dreamseed Caches.

Twilight Sky Prowler is a fox mount. It can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Creatures and Toys Outlet vendor for 500 Trader's Tender. Its original price was 750 Trader's Tender. It was originally available on the shops as part of The Twilight Pack from 1 February to 29 February 2024.
Relaxed Ducks are ducks located at the eastern tip of the Southfury Watershed in Durotar and at the river east of Westbrook Garrison in Elwynn Forest. They are encountered during Just a Waddle Away.

Reins of the Tropical Riding Crane teach the Tropical Riding Crane mount. This item can be purchased for 2,200 Bronze (Pandaria Remix) from the following vendors during Pandaria Remix: *Horos at the Timeless Shore on the Timeless Isle *Hemet Nesingwary XVII at Infinite Bazaar locations across Pandaria

Reins of the Purple Shado-Pan Riding Tiger teach the Purple Shado-Pan Riding Tiger mount. This item can be purchased for 4,400 Bronze (Pandaria Remix) from Hemet Nesingwary XVII at the Infinite Bazaar during Pandaria Remix.

Reins of the Snowy Riding Goat teach the Snowy Riding Goat mount. This item can be purchased for 2,200 Bronze (Pandaria Remix) from Hemet Nesingwary XVII at the Infinite Bazaar during Pandaria Remix.
Release the Beasts is bonus objective in Sunless Strand for players on Tricks of the Dark and Fickle Fiendish Fish.
Reins of the Slatestone Ramolith teach the Slatestone Ramolith mount. This item is an achievement reward from Allied Races: Earthen.
Relaxing Augari are draenei who attended the Tishamaat in the Trader's Tier in the Exodar.

Relentless Gladiator's Plate Armor is an 8-piece plate transmog set for Warriors. It collects the appearances of the warrior Season 7 armor, along with additional items that match visually but do not grant set bonuses. Collecting the entire set will grant the Relentlessly Good Looking achievement. ;Head *Relentless Gladiator's Plate Helm ;Shoulders *Relentless Gladiator's Plate Shoulders *Titan-Forged Shoulderplates of Triumph ;Chest *Relentless Gladiator's Plate Chestpiece ;Wrist *Relentless Gladiator's Bracers of Victory ;Hands *Relentless Gladiator's Plate Gauntlets ;Waist *Relentless Gladiator's Girdle of Victory ;Legs *Relentless Gladiator's Plate Legguards ;Feet *Relentless Gladiator's
Reins of the Sureki Skyrazor teach the Sureki Skyrazor, a skyrazor mount. This item rarely drops from Queen Ansurek in Nerub-ar Palace on any difficulty.
Reins of the Soaring Meaderbee teach the Soaring Meaderbee, a cinderbee mount. This item can be purchased for 900 Sizzling Cinderpollen from Cendvin on the Isle of Dorn.
Relaxing Residents are earthen located in Keepers Terrace, Steam Vent, and Stoneshaper's Atrium in Dornogal.
Relaxing Earthen are earthen located in Boulder Springs on the Isle of Dorn.

The Reins of the Trader's Gilded Brutosaur teaches Trader's Gilded Brutosaur, a brutosaur mount. It is a passenger mount that summons Killia and Melanie Morten, acting as both an auctioneer and mailbox, respectively. Both its form and function take from the .

Reins of the Soaring Sky Fox teach the Soaring Sky Fox mount. It is available from the Trading Post for 750 Trader's Tender. It first appeared in December 2025. It was originally sold from the Battle.net Shop as part of the The Sky Witch Pack from 2 December 2024 to 31 March 2025.
Rek the Hardened is a Maldraxxi gladiator located in the Halls of Might in the Theater of Pain. She can be seen battling Advent Nevermore, who she either kills or is slain by on approach.
Relaxed Patrons are brokers located in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Relic Archivists were man'ari eredar located at Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands during the planned Legion Invasions event.
Relentless Gusts are air elementals located in the Waking Shores.
Reins of the Starry Twilight Peafowl were never made available.
Relentless Party People are located at the Blackwater Marina and the Gallagio in the Undermine.
The Spotted Black Riding Goat is a goat mount that can be purchased at the Trading Post for 325 Trader's Tender.

Reins of the Void-Scarred Windrider teach the Void-Scarred Windrider mount. This item is a guaranteed drop from the Void-Scarred Wyvern Matriarch mob that can be summoned atop the Skyway in the Vision of Orgrimmar during Horrific Visions Revisited.

Reins of the Void-Scarred Gryphon teach the Void-Scarred Gryphon mount. This item is a guaranteed drop from the Void-Scarred Gryphon mob that can be summoned in the Trade District in the Vision of Stormwind during Horrific Visions Revisited.

Reins of the Royal Voidwing teach the Royal Voidwing, a void-infused drake mount and the Ahead of the Curve mount for . This mount is a quest reward from A Twilight Oath's End. To get the quest, players must defeat Dimensius on Heroic or Mythic difficulty and loot the Mark of the Twilight Oath before the release of .
Reins of the Slag Basilisk teach the Slag Basilisk mount. This item can be purchased for 10,000 Bronze from Hemet Nesingwary XVII at the Infinite Bazaar during Legion Remix.
Reins of the Turquoise Courser teach the Turquoise Courser, a unicorn mount. This item can be purchased for 10,000 Bronze from Hemet Nesingwary XVII at the Infinite Bazaar during Legion Remix.
Reins of the Twilight Courser teach the Twilight Courser, a unicorn mount. This item can be purchased for 10,000 Bronze from Hemet Nesingwary XVII at the Infinite Bazaar during Legion Remix.
Reins of the Wretched Fel Bat teach the Wretched Fel Bat mount. This item can be purchased for 10,000 Bronze from Hemet Nesingwary XVII at the Infinite Bazaar during Legion Remix.
Reins of the Risen Fel Bat teach the Risen Fel Bat mount. Its source was listed on the PTR as "WoW Remix: Legion," but it was never made available.
Reins of the Thorignir Drake teach the Thorignir Drake, a storm drake mount. Its source was listed on the PTR as "WoW Remix: Legion," but it was never made available.
__NOTOC__ The Reins of the Sha-scarred Drake teach the Sha-scarred Drake, a sha drake mount that is unique to Classic. This mount is not available in retail.

Reins of the Starshard Netherdrake teach the Starshard Netherdrake mount that is available as part of the Outland Heroic Pack and Outland Epic Pack since 18 November 2025. During the Burning Crusade expansion, it will be contained in the Grand Gift via the A Grand Delivery quest. In Wrath of the Lich King and beyond, it will automatically be learned and appear in the Mount Journal. This is a Classic-only mount. The retail equivalent is the Starspark Netherdrake.
Relaxing Goblin Beach Chair with Cup Gripper is housing decor purchased from Boatswain Hardee in Undermine for .
Reins of the Spectral Bear teaches Spectral Bear, a bear mount that is obtained by reaching 55 points through the Legacy System.
Remnant Charglaive drops from Smolderon in Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope.
Remarkable Weapon Crystal is created with Draenor Inscription (1); taught by Technique: Remarkable Weapon Crystal.

Relic Rescuer is a quest achievement earned by recovering relics for Eadweard Dalyngrigge and the Azerothian Archives while participating in The Big Dig: Traitor's Rest. Reliquary Key can be found in the Stone Coffer in the Scarlet Monastery Graveyard. It unlocks the Padlocked Reliquary in the Gallery of Treasures of the Scarlet Monastery Library.
Remembrance Stone is created with Khaz Algar Jewelcrafting (30); taught by Design: Remembrance Stone.
Remix: Mists of Pandaria Launch Trailer was published on 16 May 2024, the day the WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria started.
Remix: Mists of Pandaria Features and Overview was published on 13 May 2024, three days prior to the start date for WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria.
The Remembered Golden Gryphon is a gryphon mount that can be purchased for 20,000 Residual Memories from Remembrancer Amuul in Dalaran. It also teaches the Horde equivalent, Remembered Wind Rider.
The Remembered Wind Rider is a wyvern mount that can be purchased for 20,000 Residual Memories from Remembrancer Amuul in Dalaran. It also teaches the Alliance equivalent, Remembered Golden Gryphon.

Remembrancer's Radiant Jewels can be contained in Token of the Remembrancers and can be bought for from the following vendors: *Remembrancer Amuul in Dalaran *The Forgotten Hero in Dustwallow Marsh *The Memory of a Duke in the Searing Gorge *The Echo of the Silver Hand in the Dragonblight
Remembrancer Amuul is a Lightforged draenei vendor located in Dalaran. He sells rewards from the Radiant Echoes event. It is currently unknown if he survived the destruction of Dalaran.
Remembered Lich King is the Radiant Echoes boss located in the Path of the Titans in the Dragonblight. During the fight, he also summons Skeletal Horrors.
Remembered Firelord is the Radiant Echoes boss located in the Cauldron in the Searing Gorge. It is a memory of Ragnaros.
Remembered Onyxia is the Radiant Echoes boss located in Wyrmbog of Dustwallow Marsh.
Remembered Spawn is a black whelp companion. It can be bought from Remembrancer Amuul in Dalaran and the Forgotten Hero in Dustwallow Marsh for . __NOTOC__
Remembered Construct is an abomination companion. It can be bought from Remembrancer Amuul in Dalaran and the Echo of the Silver Hand in the Dragonblight for . __NOTOC__
__NOTOC__ Remembered Riverpaw is a gnoll companion. It can be bought from Remembrancer Amuul in Dalaran and the Memory of a Duke in the Searing Gorge for .

Remembered Alarm-o-Bot are alarm-o-bot projections located at the Sea of Cinders in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. During the inactive phase, they are found in the Cauldron. If left active, after aggroing, they will shoot flares at the target and summon a pack of Remembered Leper Gnomes.
Remembered Bangalash is a tiger projection located at the Sea of Cinders in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. He is the memory of King Bangalash.
Remembered Boars are boar projections located in eastern Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found southwest of Iron Summit.
Remembered Commanders are human projections located in Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found near Grimesilt Dig Site.
Remembered Crusaders are human projections located in Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found near Grimesilt Dig Site.

Remembered Defiass are human projections located east of Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge near Remembered Hogger during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found in the Cauldron and Pyrox Flats.
Remembered Ghouls are ghoul projections located in Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found at and near Grimesilt Dig Site.
Remembered Hakkar is a loa projection located in western Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. He summons Remembered Sons and is the memory of Hakkar the Soulflayer.
Remembered Sons are wind serpent projections summoned by Remembered Hakkar in Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event.
Remembered Hogger is a gnoll projection located east of Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge. He is the memory of Hogger during the Radiant Echoes event.
Relic of the Past VI is an optional crafting reagent sold by many profession vendors from to .

Remembered Kobolds are kobold projections located east of Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge with Remembered Hogger during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found in the Cauldron.

Remembered Lashtails are raptor projections located at the Sea of Cinders in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found southwest of the Iron Summit.

Remembered Leper Gnomes are leper gnome projections located at the Sea of Cinders in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found in the Cauldron. When fighting them, the Punt! extra action button becomes available.
Remembered Stitches is an abomination projection located at the upper Cauldron in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. It is the memory of Stitches.
Remembered Love Letters are scroll projections floating east of Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge near Remembered Hogger during the Radiant Echoes event.
Remembered Mechano-Tanks are mechano-tank projections located at the Sea of Cinders in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found in the Cauldron.
Remembered Patrons are dwarf projections located north of the Iron Summit in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event.
Remembered Pummeler is a crowd pummeler projection located at the Sea of Cinders in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event.
Remembered Pumpkins are projections located in Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event.
Remembered Tigers are tiger projections located at the Sea of Cinders in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they appear southwest of Iron Summit.

Remembered Bloodscalps are jungle troll projections located at the Sea of Cinders in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. During the inactive phase, they appear southwest of the Iron Summit.

Remembered Bloodpetals are bloodpetal projections located in the Dragonmurk and the Den of Flame in Dustwallow Marsh during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found south of Brackenwall Village.
Remembered Brutes are quilboar projections located in the Quagmire in Dustwallow Marsh during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found south of Brackenwall Village.
Remembered Creepers are tarantula projections located in Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found in the Quagmire.
Remembered Cubs are nightsaber projections located in Dustwallow Marsh during the Radiant Echoes event.
Remembered Charlga Razorflank is a quilboar projection located in Dustwallow Marsh during the Radiant Echoes event. She is the memory of Charlga Razorflank.
Remembered Deviate Fish are frillfish projections located in Dustwallow Marsh during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found around Direhorn Post.
Remembered Deviate Raptors are raptor projections located in Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found around Direhorn Post.

Remembered Diemetradons are diemetradon projections located in the Dragonmurk in Dustwallow Marsh during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found south of Brackenwall Village.
Remembered Darkmists are spider projections located in Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh during the Radiant Echoes event. When the event is inactive, they are found in the Quagmire.
Remembered Familiars are imp projections located in the Dragonmurk in Dustwallow Marsh during the Radiant Echoes event.

Renathal's rebellion was a civil war opposing Prince Renathal's loyalists against Sire Denathrius and his forces for the control of Revendreth. It was only after the third attempt, and with the help of the Maw Walkers, that Renathal managed to defeat his father in Castle Nathria. The Eternal One was revealed to be behind the anima drought affecting the Shadowlands and a close ally of Zovaal the Jailer. In the aftermath, Denathrius was condemned to repent under the watch of the naaru Z'rali (until he escaped), while the Court of Harvesters replaced him as the rulers of Revendreth.
